limitations: Prefabs are extracted from current zone-scene geometry and are not final collision-ready game assets.
Origins are centered for placement at the prefab footprint base; some large landmark groups may still need manual pivot tuning in-engine.
Preview renders use neutral studio lighting and are not intended to match final in-zone lighting.

created_or_replaced_prefab_families.purpose: Foreground/midground ancient living Worldroot silhouettes with twisted trunk, exposed roots, cyan bark cracks, vines, and asymmetrical canopy blobs.
Medium platform-support trees for the village architecture.
Dark organic background tree silhouettes that close the horizon.
Small grown treehouse with bark shell, cyan window, leaf roof, balcony, lantern, and Verdant motif.
Medium grown treehouse variant integrated into living trunks.
Hub-scale Memory Archive treehouse variant for the center read.
Straight, curved, and stair living-root bridge modules with clear walkable centers, root rails, vine bindings, moss, and sparse guide-runes.
Mossy stone path tiles, root borders, and elevation steps replacing flat circular path reads.

cyan_debug_reduction.rule: Cyan is reserved for Worldroot crystals, windows, bark cracks, route runes, and memory markers.

latest_thornveil_prefab_replacement_pass.layout_preservation: Camera, player spawn, central path axis, village placement, bridge line, and scene bounds are preserved.
